prompt: Artificial intelligence is increasingly being used to make decisions in areas such as recruitment, education and financial services. Some people believe these decisions should be made entirely by humans. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is often argued that decisions in areas such as recruitment, education and financial services should be made entirely by humans. However, I personally agree with the view that artificial intelligence should be used to make such decisions because it can analyse large amounts of information quickly and reduce human error.

The primary reason why I agree with this view is that artificial intelligence can analyse large amounts of information quickly. This is mainly because AI systems can process thousands of pieces of data in a very short time, whereas humans may need much more time to examine the same information. In other words, AI can compare and organise a large amount of information more efficiently than people. For example, a company can use AI to examine thousands of CVs and identify candidates whose qualifications match the requirements of a particular job. As a result, the recruitment process can become faster and more efficient. Therefore, AI can be a useful tool for making decisions.

Furthermore, another important reason why I agree with this view is that artificial intelligence can reduce human error. This is because people may make mistakes when they have to analyse a large amount of information, especially when they are tired or under pressure. For instance, a bank can use an AI system to analyse financial information and identify unusual transactions or assess loan applications systematically. Consequently, some mistakes caused by human limitations can be reduced. Therefore, I strongly agree with this view.

In conclusion, I firmly agree with the view that artificial intelligence should be used to make decisions in areas such as recruitment, education and financial services. This is mainly because artificial intelligence can analyse large amounts of information quickly and reduce human error.
